questions.q: How should inlined chunk strings from kerchunk refs be decoded into bytes?
choices: Strings starting with 'base64:' are base64-decoded, and all other strings are encoded as UTF-8 bytes (kerchunk convention)
Support only 'base64:' strings and raise an error for other strings
Same as the first option, but also accept raw bytes values, which can occur in parquet refs
doesn't matter

Both, but Parquet is a separate follow-up
doesn't matter

choices: Replace them with roundtrip tests that check the inlined bytes survive in the manifest
Keep the error but add an opt-in flag to enable inlined reading
Delete them
doesn't matter
